source: 637 Unexpected Information
target: 637 Notitia Inopinata

source: Andariel, one of the three Devil families… Lumian recognized the last name from Madam Magician and asked with a warm smile, “What brings you to Port Pylos?”
target: Andariel, unus ex tribus familiis diabolicis… Lumian cognomen a Domina Magica agnovit et, risu calido, rogavit: “Quid te ad Portum Pylos ducit?”

source: If it weren’t for the lineage running in Devil families for generations, with descendants naturally inclined towards the Criminal pathway, and the other option of the Prisoner pathway seemingly trouble‑free, Bram Andariel couldn’t shake the suspicion that the man before him carried the last name Nois or Beria.
target: Nisi ob stirpem, quae per generationes in familiis diabolicis mansit, cum progenies naturaliter ad viam criminosam inclinatae, et altera via captivorum, quae videbatur sine difficultate, Bram Andariel suspicium abicere non potuit, quin vir ante eum cognomen Nois aut Beria ferret.

source: Why did he exude more of a Devil vibe than Bram himself?
target: Cur plus spiritus diabolicus effluēbat quam ipse Bram?

source: Struggling, he lifted his right hand, wiping his swollen and cracked face, cleaning up the blood and flinging it to the ground.
target: Luctans, dextram manum levavit, vultum tumefactum et fissum abstegens, sanguinem purgans atque in terram iactavit.

source: With the task completed, Bram responded, “Firstly, it’s to gather information about Matani for the family. Secondly, it’s to find an opportunity to act as a Serial Killer. Do you know what acting is?”
target: Cum munus completum esset, Bram respondit: “Primum, ad colligendas notitias de Matani pro familia; secundo, ad inveniendam occasionem ut Interfector Serialis fungar; scisne quid sit agendi ars?”

source: He cooperated with Lumian by speaking in Intisian.
target: Cum lingua Intisiana loqueretur, cum Lumiano cooperavit.

source: Lumian nonchalantly stood before Bram, who was curled up on the ground, and remarked with a smile,
target: Lumian, indifferenter, coram Bram, qui in terra convolutus iacebat, stetit et cum risu dixit:

source: “Your acting is subpar. You don’t seem to be a criminal with a high IQ.
target: “Ars tua histrionica mediocriter se habet. Non videaris scelestus cum ingenio altissimo.”

source: “Why would the Andariel family gather information about Matani?”
target: “Cur familia Andariel notitias de Matani colligere vellet?”

source: Bram had no intention of concealing the truth for the family.
target: Bram non intendebat veritatem pro familia celare.

source: “We’re cooperating with the Rose School of Thought. They want information on this place.”
target: “Cum Schola Rosi Cogitationis cooperamus, illi notitias de hoc loco quaerunt.”

source: The Rose School of Thought setting its sights on Matani? That’s right.
target: Schola Rosi Cogitationis in Matani intendit? Ita.

source: Matani, seemingly detached from any Northern Continent nation, holds ties to the Feynapotter Kingdom, but their influence is lacking.
target: Matani, quasi a qualibet natione Continenti Septentrionali separatam, nexūs ad Regnum Feynapotter retinet, sed eius potentia caret.

source: With Admiral Querarill’s sway, even if the Rose School of Thought and the Andariel family dispatch only a handful of agents, resisting may prove challenging… Lumian perceived the stark contrast between the Southern and Northern Continents.
target: Cum potentia admiralis Querarill agirentur, etiamsi Schola Rosi Cogitationis et familia Andariel solummodo paucos agentes mitterent, resistentia ardua videbatur… Lumian discrimen acutum inter Continentes Meridionales et Septentrionales animadvertit.

source: Whether in Trier, the Feynapotter Kingdom, or the maritime colonies, Lumian encountered criminal acts and mystical disasters driven by the pursuit of strength and faith.
target: Sive in Trier, sive in Regno Feynapotter, sive in colonis maritimis, Lumian scelera criminalia et calamitas mysticae, ex studio virtutis atque fidei ortae, experivit.

source: Encroachments on factions or cities were rare, but West Balam presented a different scenario on his first day.
target: Intrusiones in factiones aut urbes rarae erant, sed West Balam in prima die rem diversam praebuit.

source: If maritime disorder resulted from chaos, the Southern Continent teemed with factional conflicts, overt or covert, causing widespread chaos.
target: Si perturbatio marina ex chao orta est, Continens Meridionalis factionum conflictibus, sive apertis sive occultis, late diffusa turbam afferebat.

source: Lumian, observing Bram’s wound clotting, questioned further, “What intel does the Rose School of Thought seek?”
target: Lumian, vulneris Brahm coagulatum observans, interrogavit: “Quas notitias Schola Rosi Cogitationis quaerit?”

source: Bram, reflecting, responded, “They want all kinds of information—cathedral locations, military camp details, patrol team compositions, port throughput, daily prices, and the locals’ lives.”
target: Bram, meditans, respondit: “Omnes species notitiarum volunt—loca cathedralium, castrorum militarum singula, ordinationem manipuli vigiliarum, fluxum portus, pretia cotidiana, atque vitas incolarum.”

source: Are they preparing to rule this place in the future? Lumian inquired, puzzled.
target: Parantne ut in futurum hunc locum regnent? Lumian perplexus interrogavit.

source: “To whom will you hand over the information you gathered? Where?”
target: “Cui trades notitias quas collegisti? Ubi?”

source: “It will be written and placed in the study of an empty house at 17 Aleg Street. My uncle, Devajo Andariel, will be responsible for retrieving it. We don’t usually contact each other, and I don’t know where he lives or under what identity,” Bram explained in detail.
target: “Scriptum erit et in studio domus vacuae in via Aleg, numero XVII, collocabitur. Avunculus meus, Devajo Andariel, eam recipere curabit. Inter nos non solimus convenire, nec scio ubi habitet aut sub qua identitate.”

source: “After becoming a Devil, his special ability is to completely skin humans and perform complicated processes to create Beyonder items with usage or time limitations. No matter who it is, as long as he wears the human skin as clothes, he can transform into the other person and complete the corresponding disguise.”
target: “Postquam Diabolus factus est, facultas eius specialis constat in hominum cutem omnimodis excindere et processus intricatos peragere ad res Beyonder creandas cum limitationibus usus aut temporis. Quicumque sit, dummodo cutem humanam ut vestimentum gerat, se in illud alterum transformare atque personam conveniens obumbrare potest.”

source: As Bram spoke, he wiped the blood off his body and flung it to the ground, as if obsessed with cleanliness.
target: Dum Bram loquebatur, sanguinem de corpore suo abstegit et in terram iactavit, quasi puritate immodica obsessus esset.

source: This was mentioned in Devilology… Lumian nodded thoughtfully.
target: Hoc in Diabolicologia commemoratum erat… Lumian cogitans annuit.

source: He pondered for a moment and asked, “Are there any traces of other Devils in Matani?”
target: Paulo meditatus interrogavit: “Num alias vestigia Diaboli in Matani sint?”

source: Perhaps Bram and his uncle weren’t the only ones sent by the Rose School of Thought to gather information.
target: Fortasse Bram et avunculus eius non soli a Schola Rosi Cogitationis missi erant ad notitias colligendas.

source: Bram shook his head.
target: Bram caput concussit.

source: “Not recently.
target: “Non nuper.

source: “However, during my investigation, I stumbled upon a string of serial murders around Port Pylos about four years back.
target: “Tamen, in inquisitione mea incidit mihi series caedum seriarum circa Portum Pylos abhinc quattuor annos.

source: “The victims lay dissected, the scene steeped in blood and marked by the aftermath of a fierce battle. Moreover, the seven casualties were no ordinary individuals; they were Beyonders, ranging from Sequence 7 to Sequence 8.”
target: “Victimae dissectae iacebant, scaena sanguine permeata et vestigiis pugnae ferocis signata. Praeterea, septem caesi non erant homines vulgares; erant Beyonder, ab Ordine VII ad Ordinem VIII.”

source: Listening intently, Lumian felt a surge of intrigue.
target: Attente auscultans, Lumian impulsum curiositatis sensit.

source: As per Franca’s explanation, the name “Hisoka” stemmed from a literary work hailing from the original world of transmigrators like themselves.
target: Secundum explanationem Francae, nomen “Hisoka” ex opere litterario, quod ex mundo originario transmigratorum similium illis proveniebat, oritur.

source: One of the character’s defining traits was an insatiable appetite for combat and the thrill of extinguishing formidable adversaries, reveling in the ecstasy and carnage of claiming lives.
target: Unum ex notis principalibus eius fuit insatiabilis appetitus ad certamen et delectatio in extasi et caede vitae sumendi, adversarios formidabiles extinguendo.

source: If the target was sufficiently potent, he’d patiently await their growth, perhaps even offer a nudge.
target: Si propositum satis potentis esset, patienter incrementum exspectaret, fortasse etiam levi impetu incitare posset.

source: Hisoka, a key member in April Fool’s, adopted this moniker as his code name, driven by an unmistakable urge for self-expression, mirroring this characteristic.
target: Hisoka, membrum clavis in “April Fool’s”, hoc cognomen ut nomen codicis assumpsit, impulsus indubitabilis sui exprimendi sequens, hanc ipsius proprietatem speculans.

source: Hisoka is a Beyonder of the Devil pathway.
target: Hisoka est Beyonder in via Diaboli.

source: Moreover, his targets are Beyonders while he was at the Serial Killer stage.
target: Praeterea, proposita eius sunt Beyonder, cum ipse in statu Interfectoris Serialis versabatur.

source: Unlike other Serial Killers, he doesn’t prey on the weak or ordinary people.
target: Dispar ab aliis Interfectoribus Serialibus, non praedatur infirmis nec vulgaribus hominibus.

source: If he had been a Serial Killer four years ago, he would likely be at least a Sequence 6 by now.
target: Si quattuor annos abhinc Interfector Serialis fuisset, nunc probabiliter saltem Sequencia VI esset.

source: There’s a strong chance he’s a Sequence 5… Yes, he’s concealed his identity very effectively.
target: Alta probabilitas est eum esse Sequenciam V… Ita, identitatem suam valde efficaciter celavit.

source: No one in the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society knows his true pathway… Lumian listened attentively to Bram’s account without interruption.
target: Nemo in Societate Inquisitionis Papionum Capillatorum veram eius viam novit… Lumian Brahmi narrationem attentive et sine intermissione auscultavit.

source: He eagerly pondered the possibility that Hisoka was a Devil or even a Desire Apostle in his mind.
target: Studiose meditatus est de possibilitate, ut Hisoka Diabolus aut etiam Apostolus Desiderii esset.

source: The curled-up Bram glanced up at him, propping his bloody palm on the ground, and straightening his body slightly.
target: Bram, convolutus, eum intuitus est, palmam sanguinolentam in terram ponens et corpus paulo extollens.

source: “This seems like the work of a Serial Killer. Moreover, he’s exceedingly confident in his strength and intellect, daring to target Beyonders. However, I noticed some discrepancies.”
target: “Hoc videtur opus Interfectoris Serialis esse. Praeterea, nimis in sua vi et ingenio confidet, audens Beyonder petere; sed nonnulla discrepantia animadverti.”

source: “What discrepancies?”
target: “Quae discrepantia?”

source: Lumian concealed his joy behind a gentle smile.
target: Lumian laetitiam suam sub tenero risu abscondit.

source: Bram shifted his palm to support himself.
target: Bram palmam vertit ad se sublevandum.

source: “Serial Killers’ victims often exhibit degraded behaviors. For instance, those I’ve selected typically share a common trait: they enjoy inflicting verbal harm and curses upon others for extended periods. Thus, I’d remove their lips and preserve them. However, the seven slain Beyonders had varying identities, backgrounds, and behaviors, lacking the typical degeneracy.”
target: “Victimae Interfectorum Serialium plerumque mores degeneratos ostendunt. Exempli gratia, illi quos selexi commune notam habent: iis placeat verbis nocere atque maledicta diuturnis modis inferre; quapropter labia eorum removerem et conservaem; sed septem interfecti Beyonder diversas identitates, origines et mores ostenderunt, carebant degeneritate typica.”

source: “Perhaps he’s merely a Beyonder with a fascination for serial killing, not necessarily acting out the Devil pathway,”
target: “Forsitan is solum est Beyonder, ob studium caedum seriarum, non vero viam Diaboli in actu exprimens,”

source: Lumian mused, masking his interest with a teasing tone. He added playfully, “Were you subjected to constant verbal violence as a child?”
target: Lumian meditatus est, studium suum cum tono iocoso abscondens, et ludenter addidit: “Num in pueritia constanti verbali violentiae affectus es?”

source: And the Coldblooded and Serial Killer potions amplified corresponding resentments and psychological traumas?
target: Et potiones Sanguinis Frigidi et Interfectoris Serialis respectiva rancores et traumatica psychologica amplificaverunt?

source: Bram fell silent, his body gradually stretching out, no longer curled up.
target: Bram siluit, corpus paulatim extendens, non iam convolutum.

source: Only then did Lumian steer the conversation back to the serial murder case from four years ago.
target: Tum tantum Lumian sermonem ad rem caedis seriarum abhinc quattuor annos redirigere constitui.

source: “Do you have detailed information about the seven Beyonders who were killed?
target: “Habesne accuratas notitias de septem Beyonder interfectis?

source: “Did you identify any suspects during the initial investigation?”
target: “Deprehendisti aliquos suspectos in inquisitione initiali?”

source: Bram shook his head slowly.
target: Bram caput lente concussit.

source: “I only had read the summary provided by the patrol team, not the full investigation files.”
target: “Tantum summam ab manipulo vigiliarum traditam legi, non plena documenta inquisitionis.”

source: “Most of the patrol team members were seasoned Beyonders who had encountered Mutants and Devils before. Their judgment should be reliable.”
target: “Plurimi ex membris manipuli vigiliarum erant periti Beyonder, qui ante Mutantes et Diaboli experti fuerant. Iudicium illorum credibile esse debet.”

source: Patrol team… Lumian grinned at Bram and remarked, “Is there any other information you deem crucial to share with me? If not, let’s proceed.”
target: Manipulus vigiliarum… Lumian Bram subridens aspiciens dixit: “An alias notitias habes, quae mihi esse cruciales videantur? Sin non, pergamus.”

source: “Yes, of course.” Bram straightened his back abruptly.
target: “Ita, scilicet.” Bram subito dorsum rectum fecit.

source: In the next moment, he spat out foul words in a language Lumian had never heard before.
target: In proximo momento, verba foeda in lingua, quam Lumian numquam ante audiverat, exspuit.

source: Devil Language!
target: Lingua Diaboli!

source: As the Devil words reverberated, the blood, bloodstains, and bloody handprints that Bram had left on the ground were enveloped in a faint light.
target: Dum verba Diaboli resonabant, sanguis, vestigia sanguinis, et manuum sanguinolentarum, quas Bram in terram reliquit, lumine levis circumdata erant.

source: A mystical connection seemed to form between them, linking them based on their location, creating sinister symbols and patterns.
target: Apparuit nexus mysticus inter eos formari, eos loco coniungens, symbola obscura et figuras creans.

source: In the room’s far cupboard, glass bottles filled with lips and colorless liquid trembled suddenly, as if rocked by an earthquake.
target: In armario remoto cubiculi, pocula vitrea, labris plena et liquore incoloro referta, subito tremuerunt, quasi terraemotus ea moveret.

source: This marked the initiation of a ritual to summon the projection of an Abyssal Devil!
target: Hoc inauguravit initium rituum ad speciem Abyssalis Diaboli evocandam!

source: Serial Killers executed serial murders not solely for the thrill but also to appease the Abyssal Devils.
target: Caedes Interfectorum Serialium non solum ob delectationem peraguntur, sed etiam ad placandos Abyssales Diaboli.

source: Once the killing spree concluded, Serial Killers could proceed to the final step of the ritual, summoning the projection of the corresponding Abyssal Devil.
target: Postquam caedes finitae sunt, Interfectorēs Serialēs ad gradum ultimum rituum procedere possunt, speciem Abyssalis Diaboli evocantes.

source: This granted them the assistance needed to fulfill their desires.
target: Hoc eis auxilium necessarium ad desidera perficienda tribuebat.

source: Though Bram’s string of murders wasn’t entirely finished and fell short by a few targets, he had met the minimum threshold.
target: Quamquam series caedum Brahmi non omnino perfecta erat et paucis scopis defuisset, tamen minimum terminum attingebat.

source: It satisfied the basic quantitative requirements, allowing him to expedite the ritual.
target: Id requisita quantitatis fundamentalia implevit, idque ei permittens ritu accelerare.

source: Understandably, this shortcut wouldn’t yield the same effectiveness as the standard procedure.
target: Intellegendum est, haec via brevis non eandem efficaciam quam procedura ordinaria praebebat.

source: Yet, in the face of urgency and danger, Bram paid little heed.
target: Attamen, in facie urgendi et periculi, Bram parum attendit.

source: He cooperated willingly, divulging information to divert the enemy’s focus from his subtle actions.
target: Ille libenter cooperatus est, notitias enarrans, ut hostis ab subtili actu suo distraheretur.

source: For instance, allowing blood to drip onto the ground in a specific pattern and pressing his blood‑stained palm in a particular location.
target: Exempli causa, sanguinem in terram in forma particulari stillare sinens et palmam sanguinolentam in loco determinato premens.

source: These marks replaced conspicuous evil and degenerate symbols with subtler, blood‑stained alternatives.
target: Haec signa, conspicua mala et symbola degenerata, substituebant alternativas subtiliores, sanguine maculatas.

source: With the preparations complete, Bram could utilize the Devil Language’s “activate” to trigger the ritual, pleasing a high‑level Devil and summoning its projection to confront the enemy!
target: Cum praeparationes completae essent, Bram uti poterat verbo “activate” linguae Diaboli ad ritum incitandum, altissimum Diabolum placens et eius speciem evocans ut hostem oppugnaret!

source: Lumian silently observed Bram Andariel’s “handiwork,” feeling the room steeped in malevolence and tainted by corruption.
target: Lumian silentiose Bram Andariel operam observabat, sentiens conclave malevolentia imbutum et corruptione tinctum.

source: He raised his right hand, snapping his fingers.
target: Dextram manum attoluit, digitos crepitantes pulsans.

source: Bram, coldly observing him while anticipating the ritual’s protection, suddenly heard a rumbling emanate from within his body.
target: Bram, eum frigidē intuentem et protectionem rituum exspectans, subito audivit fremitus ex corpore suo emanare.

source: In confusion, he lowered his head and scrutinized his form.
target: In confusione, caput deiecit et formam suam scrutatus est.

source: Crimson flames erupted from within, inflicting the agony of violent waves tearing through his internal organs, bones, and flesh.
target: Flammae coccineae ex intus erupere coeperunt, inferentes dolorem undarum violentarum quae organa interna, ossa et carnem lacerabant.

source: Darkness gripped Bram’s consciousness, accompanied by searing pain.
target: Tenebrae conscie Brahmi arripuerunt, comitatae dolore urente.

source: The last sight before losing consciousness: A black‑haired young man with green eyes, sporting a golden straw hat, curved his lips, maintaining a warm smile. It was as though he watched a clown diligently tumble into a trap.
target: Ultima visio antequam conscientiam amisit: iuvenis, capillis nigris et oculis viridibus, pileum strara aureum gerens, labra incurvata, risum calidum obtinens. Videbatur quasi spectaret histrionem diligenter in laqueum incidere.

source: Rumble!
target: Fremitus!

source: The ritual concluded prematurely. An explosion originating from Bram’s body tore him into multiple fragments.
target: Ritus praecox concludebatur. Explosio ex corpore Brahm orta eum in varias partes distraxit.

source: Fire Infusion and Delayed Explosion!
target: Infusio Ignis et Explosio Dilata!

source: As Lumian adorned the Fury of the Sea brooch and ruthlessly assailed Bram, he not only released pent‑up emotions but also covertly infused flames into Bram’s body, triggering a Delayed Explosion.
target: Dum Lumian fibulam “Furiae Maris” induebatur et Brahm immitis opponebat, non solum affectus repositos dimittere sed etiam clam flammis in corpus eius infundebat, Explosio Dilata excitans.

source: This precaution aimed to avert any mishaps.
target: Haec cautio ad casus vitandos destinata erat.

source: Moreover, there was no intention of granting forgiveness or negotiating a deal to spare Bram.
target: Praeterea, nullus erat propositus veniam dare aut de pacto tractare, ut Brahm parceretur.

source: Thus, there existed no psychological barrier to implanting a controlled time bomb within his body, ready to be activated.
target: Ergo, nihil obstaculum psychologicum exsistebat ad bombam temporalis moderatam in corpore eius implanendam, quae activari parata esset.

source: Rumble!
target: Fremitus!

source: Corpse fragments scattered across the room, some plastering the walls. Yet, this tumultuous event remained contained within the confines of the Bottle of Fiction.
target: Fragmenta cadaveris per conclave sparsa sunt, nonnulla parietes adhaerentes. Attamen, hic tumultus intra limites “Vas Fictum” retentus est.
